verdict.rationale: Skyvern's products page documents its own global residential proxy network with country, state and city-level targeting across 20+ countries, which covers the proxy and geo-targeting half of the story. Nothing in the pack describes stealth fingerprinting: the 'captcha-and-bot-bypass' docs page is cited only for CAPTCHA solving, which is a different capability. missing for 10: evidence of stealth or browser-fingerprint controls, docs on how to enable or configure proxies per run (API/SDK parameter), independent or hands-on corroboration that automations avoid bot blocking.
